scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: tsc -b && vite build --mode chrome && vite build --mode chrome --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:firefox: tsc -b && vite build --mode firefox && vite build --mode firefox --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --mode firefox --config vite.background.config.ts
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.dev:chrome: cross-env WATCH=1 concurrently "npm run dev:ts" "vite build --mode chrome --watch" "vite build --mode chrome --config vite.content.config.ts --watch"
scripts.dev:firefox: cross-env WATCH=1 concurrently "npm run dev:ts" "vite build --mode firefox --watch" "vite build --mode firefox --config vite.content.config.ts --watch" "vite build --mode firefox --config vite.background.config.ts --watch"
scripts.dev: cross-env WATCH=1 concurrently "tsc -b --watch" "vite build --mode chrome --watch" "vite build --mode chrome --config vite.content.config.ts --watch" "vite build --mode firefox --watch" "vite build --mode firefox --config vite.content.config.ts --watch" "vite build --mode firefox --config vite.background.config.ts --watch"
